result.rationale: Research establishes Nopetro Renewables, LLC as a distinct NOVA Fund I RNG platform and establishes NOVA and Nopetro Energy Holdings as co-owners, but the current direct owner set remains unresolved because Green Group may hold direct platform equity outside its NOVA relationship. Defer creation rather than inventing or omitting a current owner.
